style.character: Flat vector character illustration, full body from head to shoes, clean geometric shapes, soft gentle shading, friendly simple face, palette of navy #1F3A5F, mid blue #5C80A3, light blue #A6CDF5, teal #39B8B0 and warm yellow #F4C542, isolated on a transparent background, no floor, no shadow, no text, centred, modern corporate explainer style.
style.prop: Flat vector illustration object, clean geometric shapes, soft gentle shading, palette of navy #1F3A5F, mid blue #5C80A3, light blue #A6CDF5, teal #39B8B0 and warm yellow #F4C542, isolated on a transparent background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no logos.
style.backdrop: Flat vector illustration of an empty modern office interior backdrop in a soft blue palette (pale blue walls #DEE8F8, mid blue #A6CDF5 accents, navy details), wide 3:2, clean geometric shapes, no people, no text, no logos, the lower two thirds are an open empty floor area.

maya.desc: Maya, a security lead: woman in her 30s, short dark bob haircut, navy blazer over a teal top, grey trousers, white sneakers, standing relaxed facing the viewer, arms by her sides.

poses.maya_worried: she is stressed, one hand on her forehead, the other hand holding a phone, worried expression, slight lean.
poses.maya_point: she points with her right arm extended to the viewer's left at something off to the side, confident explaining expression, body turned slightly left.
poses.maya_confident: she stands with arms crossed and a relaxed confident smile.

leo.desc: Leo, a software developer: young man with curly dark hair and light beard, light blue hoodie with a white t-shirt, navy jeans, yellow sneakers, standing relaxed facing the viewer, holding a closed laptop under one arm.

poses.leo_typing: he holds an open laptop on one forearm and types on it with the other hand, focused expression, laptop screen facing away from viewer.
poses.leo_shrug: he shrugs with both palms up, confused puzzled expression, the laptop set aside is not visible.
poses.leo_happy: he gives a cheerful thumbs up with a big smile, laptop under the other arm.

bot.desc: An AI coding agent mascot: a small friendly rounded robot with a white glossy body, a navy face screen with two teal glowing eyes, a short antenna with a yellow tip, small arms, floating with no legs, facing the viewer, waving one hand.

poses.bot_working: the robot types busily on a small floating translucent keyboard, eyes focused, small code symbols floating around.
poses.bot_alarm: the robot is alarmed and frozen, its eyes turned red, arms raised, a small red warning triangle floating above its head.
poses.bot_happy: the robot is happy, eyes curved in a smile, giving a thumbs up, a small teal check mark floating beside it.

auditor.desc: An external auditor: man in his 50s with grey hair and glasses, charcoal grey suit and navy tie, standing facing the viewer, holding a tablet against his chest.

poses.auditor_happy: he smiles and extends his right hand forward for a handshake, tablet in the other hand.

desk.desc: A modern office desk seen from the front at slight angle with a large monitor and a keyboard on it, an office chair behind the desk, empty, nobody sitting. The monitor screen is plain light blue and empty.

whiteboard.desc: A large freestanding whiteboard on a stand, seen straight on, the board surface completely blank white with a thin grey frame, empty.

laptop.desc: An open modern laptop seen from the front three-quarter view, the screen shows a large teal shield with a white check mark on a navy background.

server.desc: A tall server rack cabinet with several units and small teal and yellow status lights, front view.

cloud_shield.desc: A soft light-blue cloud with a large navy shield in front of it, the shield has a white check mark, gentle glow.

plant.desc: A tall potted monstera office plant in a white pot, front view.

bg_office.desc: A back wall with a large window showing a pale city skyline, a shelf with books and small plants, framed pictures, a pendant lamp.

bg_meeting.desc: A meeting room back wall with a big blank wall-mounted screen showing nothing, a low credenza with a plant, soft window light.

bg_plain.desc: Just a clean back wall with a subtle horizontal band, a couple of hanging lamps and a small framed picture, very minimal.
